description:
The complete MaleCNS connectome from the Janelia FlyEM Team Project and the Cambridge Drosophila Connectomics Group, covering the brain and nerve cord, 166k neurons.

- [Project overview](https://www.janelia.org/project-team/flyem/male-cns-connectome)
- Companion sites:
    - [Male CNS Connectome Site](https://janelia-flyem.github.io/male-cns)
    - [Cell Type Explorer](https://reiserlab.github.io/celltype-explorer-drosophila-male-cns)
    - [Base neuroglancer scene](https://neuroglancer-demo.appspot.com/#!gs://flyem-male-cns/v0.9/male-cns-v0.9.json)
    - [Clio](https://clio.janelia.org/ws/annotate?dataset=male-cns:v0.9&tab=bodies)
